name: Four Photo Stop Motion
summary: Cycle four photos as a beat-synced stop motion with blur hits, a black pause and a dark fade, over bundled music, as editable Image clips.

compatibility.selects: Needs the editor's existing original Image placement service (same as Four Photo Reveal and Camera Shutter Dump), public clip effects, motion graphics and Audio overlays; no Node.js. Verified in Selects Staging and a local develop build on 2026-10-01: saved Draft readback and export. The Node-free panel (2026-10-01) passed its local tests but has not yet been run in the app. Windows (2026-10-02): the music is found through the host FileSystem, with no shell command; a Windows pass on the Staging build is pending.
